Treatments

How I can help you

I work with many clinics and hospitals in Istanbul. I choose the doctor for each patient individually, and I interpret and stay with you throughout your stay.

Free consultation

  • Dentistry

    Hollywood Smile · Veneers · Crowns · Implants

    The most common reason my patients come. From single crowns to a complete smile makeover.

    5–10 days typical stay for veneers and crowns

  • Plastic surgery

    Face · Nose · Breasts · Body

    Face and body procedures with experienced surgeons. I am with you during recovery too.

    7–10 days typical stay for most procedures

  • Hair transplant

    Hair · Beard · Eyebrows

    Istanbul is one of the world's most popular places for a hair transplant. I help you choose a doctor you can trust.

    2–3 days in Istanbul are usually enough

  • Bariatric surgery

    Gastric sleeve · Bypass · Balloon

    Weight-loss surgery after medical assessment. We stay in touch after you get home.

    5–7 days typical stay in Istanbul

  • Eye surgery

    Laser vision correction · Cataract · Lens replacement

    Laser vision correction and other eye procedures. I choose the centre for your case.

    3–4 days typical stay in Istanbul

  • Ask about another treatment

    Don't see your treatment here? I help with other treatments too. Write to me and I will check what I can do for you.

    The consultation is free and without obligation

How I choose the doctor

I do not name clinics on this site, because I choose the doctor for each person. After the consultation I will tell you exactly where and with whom you will be treated.

  • Experience in your treatment

    I look for a doctor who performs exactly the treatment you need every day.

  • Patient feedback

    I take into account my patients' experience and how the clinic looks after them after treatment.

  • Conditions at the clinic

    I know the clinics and hospitals I work with. I know what they are like inside.

  • Your budget

    I look for a solution that fits your means. You know the price before you travel.
